tei:div.tei:p: ༈ oṃ swa sti/ bdag dge slong sangs rgyas phun tshogs kyis 'khrul snang rmi lam sna tshogs las/ dad pa can gyi nan gyis bskul nas cung zad dran pa bris na/ lan cig 'jam dbyangs bsod nams dbang phyug las ras bris kyi dkyil 'khor la brten nas kye rdor rgyu dbang tshar gcig thob pa gsal po byung / yang lan cig rje sa chen gyi sku gsal po byung / yang rje btsun sgrol ma'i sku brnyan lan mang du byung / phur pa'i bsnyen pa'i dus phur pa dang rje sa chen gyi sku brnyan gsal po byung / bse 'bag nag po 'phur shes ma mjal gong du gsal po rmis pa la phyis dngos mjal dus nges shes 'drongs pa byung / lan gcig dpal mgon zhal bzhi pa'i yum chen sring mo bzhi byung / yang sgrub dus mgon po zhal khra can byung / yang mgon po'i bsnyen pa'i tshe rtags sna tshogs byung zhing / ngor gyi gdan sa byed dgos pa dang sdig pa cung zad dag pa'i rtags byung / thub pa'i gser sku chen po gcig kyang gsal po byung / gzhan yang rang gi bla ma rnams gsal po mjal ba mang du byung / khyad par rje btsun rin po che grags pa rgyal mtshan gos chen gser byus dkar po'i phod ka gsol ba seng ge dkar po la chibs pa zhig gsal po byung / slob dpon padma'i lder sku che ba zhig gsal bar byung / gzhan yang mchod rten dang / glegs bam dang / lha mang po'i gzugs brnyan byung yang ngos ma zin/ dpe cha'i zhu dag mang po byas tshe chu gtsang ma'i rgyun las 'thung ba dang / 'o ma dang / mar dkar dang / ral gri dang / snag tsha dang / snyug gu la sogs pa rmi ba byung / 'jam dbyangs kyi bsnyen pa'i tshe 'jam dbyangs me tog sogs rmi ba byung / 'jam dbyangs sa paṇa gyi gser sku zhig la sku khrus gsol ba rmis shing / yang lan cig yum chen sring mo bzhi yin snyam pa zhig gis/ dgos don min spyi don la brag rdzong ma'i drag po'i sbyin sreg brgya rtsa dgos zer ba zhig byung /

yang lan cig glo bo mkhan chen bsod nams lhun grub kyis zhal nas bkra shis kyi tshigs su bcad pa 'ga' zhig gsung ba byung / gzhan yang mang po brjed gnang / mi chos bla ma dang / sdig pa gsog pa'i rgyur ma gyur cig shing sprel zla ba bcu gcig pa'i nyi shu bzhi'i tho rangs/ sprul pa'i lha khang chen mor zhabs drung a mi'i drung gis bzhengs pa'i sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' dpag med gzigs gsung zhing / de rnams la rje bla mas bstod pa'i tshigs su bcad pa mang po byas pas brjed song gsung / gong ma lnga la sogs pa'i bla ma mang po yang bzhugs 'dug pa 'di rnams mthong bas don chen po 'grub pa yin gsung ngo / /yang lo de'i zla ba bcu gnyis pa'i tshes dgu'i nyi shar tsam la mnal la srib tsam song ring la rje bla ma zhal nub phyogs la gzigs yod cing / dpal gur gyi mgon po zhal byang phyogs la gzigs nas gaṇḍe phyag g.yas pas 'phyar thabs su 'dzin nas bzlog pa mdzad pa'i rnam 'gyur byung gsung ngo / /bkra shis shog/ // PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 2 sangs rgyas phun tshogs/ bdag dge slong sangs rgyas phun tshogs kyis 'khrul snang rmi lam sna tshogs las/ PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 1
